entities.name: Esteban Pérez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Esteban Daniel Pérez Spatazza is a retired male basketball player from Argentina, who competed for his native country at the 1996 Summer Olympics in Atlanta, Georgia, finishing in ninth place in the overall-rankings. He was nicknamed "Gallo" during his career.
